uncertainty.method: local Gaussian, known supplied covariance; no chi2 rescaling; null directions return null

diagnostics.message: The fit tracks a compact-lens exterior. It does not establish a black-hole horizon.
Recovery uses declared synthetic measurements, not an empirical detection.
The scalar flux is fixed to the declared regular-body proxy. It is not a black-hole horizon selection.

provenance.description: Declared measurement errors are experimental inputs, not an instrument forecast or detection.

data_summary.covariance: full supplied positive-definite covariance; row order preserved

physics_admission.scope: retained weak-metric, frozen-background, quasistatic R1 exterior
physics_admission.hidden_boundary_components: xz and yz fixed to zero in this template family

boundary_state.nonlinear_principal_scale_definition: Kangular * ||deltaPi||F; residual bound is not a solution-error bound

source_pairing.boundary_condition: specified Dirichlet or conormal worldtube state

limits: Bounds certify the retained local QS principal coefficients and perturbation size, not full covariant stability or observational accuracy.
Line-of-sight projection is the declared decaying local extension; cosmological matching and time corrections remain separate model errors.
No near-horizon boundary value or black-hole charge follows from regular-body or worldtube proxy provenance.

conditional_envelope.cap_definition: uniform sufficient retained-action admission bound; not a selected astrophysical amplitude
conditional_envelope.interpretation: Local GLS information after source/lens and axial profiling. Outside-cap unconstrained estimates are not physical R1 state measurements. No horizon/detection claim.
conditional_envelope.normalization: unit L2 scalar Dirichlet amplitudes; one metric response; same supplied covariance
conditional_envelope.derivative_accuracy: symmetric base-Hessian directional derivative at relative annulus step1e-4

bhsm_interpretation.model_role: One compact-configuration optical response described in BHSM boundary/envelope language.
bhsm_interpretation.one_potential_rule: Equivalent ordinary-gravity and BHSM envelope descriptions represent the same fitted lens potential and are counted once. A separately derived response is added only when it is a distinct term of the same physical model.

parameter_meanings.interpretation: Action metric/source mass of the adopted conditional R1 compact configuration; the predicted optical response includes its scalar term.
parameter_meanings.qualification: It is the mass coefficient of the fitted optical model. It does not by itself determine a microscopic state, a surface energy, a horizon radius or a topological charge.

parameter_meanings.interpretation: Reference position and observer-frame translation of that same boundary/envelope optical response.
parameter_meanings.qualification: This tracks the center of the adopted exterior template in the supplied frame; source freedom and environmental structure remain in the inference.

parameter_meanings.interpretation: Projected compact angular structure, which can represent a coarse boundary/envelope deformation when its physical source is specified.
parameter_meanings.qualification: A coefficient alone does not select a BHSM surface mode. An equivalent envelope quadrupole is not added again as an independent force.

parameter_meanings.interpretation: Tidal and focusing terms of the surrounding optical environment.
parameter_meanings.qualification: They are fitted environmental freedoms, not automatically intrinsic deformations of the compact configuration.

bhsm_interpretation.inference_scope: The ordinary fit is usable with this BHSM interpretation. Agreement with the ordinary lens response is allowed; a non-GR residual is not required. The fit alone does not uniquely identify the microscopic theory or a horizon.
bhsm_interpretation.conditional_extension: R1 evaluates an explicitly conditional scalar boundary-to-metric response from the adopted effective action. Its flux and boundary-state assumptions remain separate from the ordinary mass/motion interpretation.
bhsm_interpretation.weyl_convention: The tracker propagates W_full=Phi+Psi. A BHSM source using W_topo=(Phi_topo+Psi_topo)/2 contributes 2*W_topo to that same full Weyl response, not a second copy of an already represented term.

spherical_boundary.reason: The Schwarzschild boundary identity is not substituted into the modified R1 metric. Its total boundary energy needs the corresponding metric and reference subtraction.

source_provenance.scope: BHSM adopted gravitational-sector interpretation of one ordinary optical response; no microscopic or horizon identification claimed
source_provenance.weyl_convention: Tracker W_full=Phi+Psi; the separate BHSM optical contract defines W_topo=(Phi_topo+Psi_topo)/2
